# Support

## Where to get help

**Questions and "how do I..." belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/delightaheebwa/learning-system/discussions)**,
not the issue tracker. Please use it first:

- 💡 **Ideas** — propose a change or improvement.
- 🙏 **Q&A** — ask how something works; answers can be marked as the solution.
- 🙌 **Show and tell** — share what you built or learned with the system.
- 📝 **Build Log** — follow along with what shipped, broke, and is next.

## Before asking

1. Search existing discussions — your question may already be answered.
2. Read [`README.md`](../README.md) for the overview and the canonical pi runtime,
   [`OPENWEBUI.md`](../OPENWEBUI.md) only for the frozen legacy Open WebUI guide.
3. Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) if you are modifying the repo — it covers the
   conventions and gotchas.
4. For pi runtime / gate / skills behavior, read [`learning-pi/README.md`](https://github.com/delightaheebwa/learning-pi)
   and [`AUDIT-ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/delightaheebwa/learning-pi/blob/main/AUDIT-ROADMAP.md).

## Bug reports

Use the issue tracker for concrete bugs and tracked feature work. Include your environment, the steps
to reproduce, and what you expected versus what happened. Route by layer:
pi runtime / gate / skills / prompts → [`learning-pi/issues`](https://github.com/delightaheebwa/learning-pi/issues);
state / wiki / Open WebUI snapshot → [learning-system issues](https://github.com/delightaheebwa/learning-system/issues).

## Security

Do **not** report security issues publicly. See [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md), and the
[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that applies to all community spaces.
